review_type: Drafting-assistant bilingual self-reread; not human or independent scholarly review

rows.rationale: Keeps the address to children and the qualification in the Lord.
rows.before: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, because this is right.
rows.after: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
rows.tsw_comparator: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
rows.exact_source_record: Τὰ τέκνα, ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν ὑμῶν ἐν κυρίῳ, τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν δίκαιον·

rows.rationale: Preserves both parents and the narrator's explanation within the quotation.
rows.before: “Honor your father and mother”—which is the first commandment with a promise—
rows.after: “Honor your father and mother”—this is the first commandment with a promise—
rows.tsw_comparator: “Honor your father and mother”—which is the first commandment with a promise—
rows.exact_source_record: τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα, ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐντολὴ πρώτη ἐν ἐπαγγελίᾳ,

rows.rationale: Keeps both promised outcomes and the earth/land wording without narrowing geography.
rows.before: “so that it may go well with you and you may live long on the earth.”
rows.after: “so that things may go well for you and you may live long on the earth.”
rows.tsw_comparator: “so that it may be well with you and that you may live long in the land.”
rows.exact_source_record: ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ ἔσῃ μακροχρόνιος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

rows.rationale: Retains the specific fathers and the contrast between provocation and nurture.
rows.before: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
rows.after: And fathers, do not provoke your children to anger. Instead, nurture them in the Lord's discipline and instruction.
rows.tsw_comparator: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
rows.exact_source_record: Καὶ οἱ πατέρες, μὴ παροργίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφετε αὐτὰ ἐν παιδείᾳ καὶ νουθεσίᾳ κυρίου.

rows.rationale: Names slavery plainly and retains fear, trembling, sincerity and the Christ comparison.
rows.before: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with fear and trembling, in sincerity of heart, as you would Christ,
rows.after: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with fear and trembling and with a sincere heart, as you would Christ.
rows.tsw_comparator: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and trembling, in singleness of heart, as you would Christ;
rows.exact_source_record: Οἱ δοῦλοι, ὑπακούετε τοῖς ⸂κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις⸃ μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου ἐν ἁπλότητι τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς τῷ Χριστῷ,

rows.rationale: Unpacks eye-service naturally while retaining the repeated slave relationship.
rows.before: not with eye-service as people-pleasers, but as Christ’s slaves doing God’s will from the heart.
rows.after: Do not work only while someone is watching, trying to win human approval. Work as Christ's slaves, doing God's will from the heart.
rows.tsw_comparator: not by way of eye-service, as people-pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
rows.exact_source_record: μὴ κατʼ ὀφθαλμοδουλίαν ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι ἀλλʼ ὡς ⸀δοῦλοι Χριστοῦ ποιοῦντες τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐκ ψυχῆς

rows.rationale: Keeps the contrast in the orientation of service and connects the sentence to its reason.
rows.before: Serve with goodwill as serving the Lord and not people,
rows.after: Serve with goodwill, as though serving the Lord and not people,
rows.tsw_comparator: rendering service with goodwill, as to the Lord and not to people,
rows.exact_source_record: μετʼ εὐνοίας δουλεύοντες, ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις,

rows.rationale: Retains the equal scope of recompense without making slavery metaphorical here.
rows.before: knowing that whatever good each person does, they will receive back from the Lord, whether slave or free.
rows.after: knowing that the Lord will repay each person for whatever good they do, whether slave or free.
rows.tsw_comparator: knowing that whatever good anyone does, this they will receive back from the Lord, whether slave or free.
rows.exact_source_record: εἰδότες ὅτι ⸂ἕκαστος, ὃ ἂν⸃ ποιήσῃ ἀγαθόν, τοῦτο ⸀κομίσεται ⸀παρὰ κυρίου, εἴτε δοῦλος εἴτε ἐλεύθερος.

rows.rationale: Makes the command to cease threats audible and preserves their shared Master.
rows.before: Masters, do the same things toward them, giving up threats, knowing that both their Master and yours is in heaven and that there is no partiality with him.
rows.after: And masters, treat them in the same way, and stop threatening them. You know that their Master and yours is in heaven, and he shows no favoritism.
rows.tsw_comparator: And masters, do the same to them. Stop your threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
rows.exact_source_record: Καὶ οἱ κύριοι, τὰ αὐτὰ ποιεῖτε πρὸς αὐτούς, ἀνιέντες τὴν ἀπειλήν, εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ ⸂αὐτῶν καὶ ὑμῶν⸃ ὁ κύριός ἐστιν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ προσωπολημψία οὐκ ἔστιν παρʼ αὐτῷ.

rows.rationale: Expresses dependence on divine strength rather than self-generated resolve.
rows.before: Finally, be strengthened in the Lord and in the power of his might.
rows.after: Finally, draw your strength from the Lord and his mighty power.
rows.tsw_comparator: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
rows.exact_source_record: ⸂Τοῦ λοιποῦ⸃ ἐνδυναμοῦσθε ἐν κυρίῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ κράτει τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ.

rows.rationale: Retains the repeated against and the nonhuman scope without identifying present-day groups.
rows.before: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood but against rulers, authorities, the cosmic powers of this darkness, and spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
rows.after: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against rulers, against authorities, against the powers that rule this darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
rows.tsw_comparator: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers of this present darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly places.
rows.exact_source_record: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἡ πάλη πρὸς αἷμα καὶ σάρκα, ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὰς ἀρχάς, πρὸς τὰς ἐξουσίας, πρὸς τοὺς κοσμοκράτορας τοῦ ⸀σκότους τούτου, πρὸς τὰ πνευματικὰ τῆς πονηρίας ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις.

rows.rationale: Preserves the evil day and the repeated standing motif.
rows.before: Therefore take up the full armor of God so that you may be able to resist in the evil day and, after accomplishing everything, to stand.
rows.after: So take up God's full armor, so that you can resist on the evil day and, having done everything, stand.
rows.tsw_comparator: Therefore take up the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand on the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
rows.exact_source_record: διὰ τοῦτο ἀναλάβετε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα δυνηθῆτε ἀντιστῆναι ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πονηρᾷ καὶ ἅπαντα κατεργασάμενοι στῆναι.

rows.rationale: Retains readiness, footwear and the paradoxical peace message within armor imagery.
rows.before: and with your feet prepared with the readiness of the good news of peace.
rows.after: and with your feet fitted with the readiness that comes from the good news of peace.
rows.tsw_comparator: and as shoes for your feet, the readiness given by the gospel of peace.
rows.exact_source_record: καὶ ὑποδησάμενοι τοὺς πόδας ἐν ἑτοιμασίᾳ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς εἰρήνης,

rows.rationale: Follows in all rather than above all and retains shield and flaming projectiles.
rows.before: In every situation take up the shield of trust, with which you will be able to extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
rows.after: In every situation, take up the shield of faith. With it you will be able to put out all the evil one's flaming arrows.
rows.tsw_comparator: In all circumstances take up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one;
rows.exact_source_record: ⸀ἐν πᾶσιν ἀναλαβόντες τὸν θυρεὸν τῆς πίστεως, ἐν ᾧ δυνήσεσθε πάντα τὰ βέλη τοῦ ⸀πονηροῦ πεπυρωμένα σβέσαι·

rows.rationale: Keeps receive and the source's identification of the sword with divine speech.
rows.before: Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is God’s word.
rows.after: Receive the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is God's word.
rows.tsw_comparator: and take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
rows.exact_source_record: καὶ τὴν περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σωτηρίου ⸀δέξασθε, καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν τοῦ πνεύματος, ὅ ἐστιν ῥῆμα θεοῦ,

rows.rationale: Makes the extended prayer instruction readable and preserves all/every repetition.
rows.before: Pray at every time in the Spirit with every kind of prayer and request. To this end stay alert with all perseverance and prayer for all the holy ones,
rows.after: Pray in the Spirit at every opportunity, with every kind of prayer and petition. To that end, stay alert and persevere in prayer for all the saints.
rows.tsw_comparator: With every prayer and petition, pray at all times in the Spirit; and to that end, keep alert with all perseverance, making supplication for all the saints.
rows.exact_source_record: διὰ πάσης προσευχῆς καὶ δεήσεως, προσευχόμενοι ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ ἐν πνεύματι, καὶ εἰς ⸀αὐτὸ ἀγρυπνοῦντες ἐν πάσῃ προσκαρτερήσει καὶ δεήσει περὶ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων,

rows.rationale: Retains the ambassador/chains contrast and repeated boldness.
rows.before: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may speak boldly in it as I ought to speak.
rows.after: It is for this good news that I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may speak about it boldly, as I ought.
rows.tsw_comparator: for which I am an ambassador in chains, that I may declare it boldly, as I ought to speak.
rows.exact_source_record: ὑπὲρ οὗ πρεσβεύω ἐν ἁλύσει, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ παρρησιάσωμαι ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι.

rows.rationale: Renders incorruptibility as enduring love while recording the broader attachment in a note.
rows.before: Grace be with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with undying love.
rows.after: Grace be with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
rows.tsw_comparator: Grace be with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with love incorruptible.
rows.exact_source_record: ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἀγαπώντων τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν ⸀ἀφθαρσίᾳ.
